subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `captionedFinalText` as a public channel-plugin capability and enable bundled voice captions by default for Telegram final-mode TTS?
rationale: This creates a permanent plugin contract that authorizes core text suppression and changes Telegram's existing message presentation; correctness tests alone cannot authorize that product and compatibility direction.

options.title: Approve bundled captions
options.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after per-send recovery is fixed and current-head Telegram proof shows no duplication.

options.title: Add delivery choice first
options.body: Support both bundled and separate text-plus-voice presentation before changing Telegram's existing default.

options.title: Keep policy Telegram-private
options.body: Implement the fix through a bundled Telegram seam without exposing shared core suppression semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled captions
recommendation.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after per-send recovery is fixed and current-head Telegram proof shows no duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the cross-cutting auto-reply, ACP, and channel-capability boundaries, and no narrower CODEOWNERS entry owns this decision.
